summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of CipherBox through the full GSD pipeline: parallel worktree execution of 5 plans, code review, simplify, validation, security reviews, and PR creation with post-PR bot review resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 50 completed and verified (3/3 HARD-01 must-haves), PR #527 opened, CodeRabbit findings being applied. All 5 plans merged across 2 waves with 93 targeted tests green and full typecheck passing.

repo: api-client regeneration via `pnpm api:generate` resolves to workspace root even inside git worktrees (no own node_modules), leaking 131 regenerated files into the main checkout after worktree plan execution

The cleanup-wave helper's internal merge commit silently fails when the pre-commit hook (check-api-client.sh + pnpm lint-staged across 131 generated files) exits non-zero — leaving MERGE_HEAD in place with no stderr output; requires manual `git commit` with generous timeout

Husky post-commit/post-rewrite hooks regenerate api-client into the main working tree after merge commits, causing subsequent worktree merges to fail with 'would be overwritten'; fix: discard leaked working-tree files after confirming they match the incoming worktree branch exactly

`todos/done/` (70 items, frozen) and `todos/completed/` (20 items, active) coexisted as dual resolved-todo folders; GSD tooling references only `completed/` — drift from a mid-project GSD update that never backfilled old items
GSD init query misparses `'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)'` as phantom dependency `1.1`, blocking auto-recommendations for phases with parenthetical dep descriptions
The gsd commit helper (`gsd_run query commit`) reliably gives a false-negative `commit_failed` response despite the commit actually landing — always verify with `git log` before retrying
Phase 50 `rowDeleted = true` in vault.service.ts was set unconditionally after `delete()`, so `fileUnpins.inc()` fired even on 0-row deletes (CodeRabbit finding post-PR)
Greptile hard-declines PRs with >~200 files; the 131-file api-client regen + 95 planning docs reliably exceeds its limit on any PR involving DTO changes
CodeRabbit CLI reviews doc artifacts (REVIEW.md pre-fix vs VERIFICATION.md post-fix) as consistency findings, not just code
Pre-commit hook runs eslint+prettier across all staged api-client files on every commit — accounts for ~2min latency on merge commits involving the api-client regen
`.husky/_/` hook stubs are auto-generated and untracked when `pnpm install` runs inside a worktree — makes the worktree appear dirty to the merge helper before plan work is even committed

code.finding: `rowDeleted = true` set unconditionally after TypeORM `delete()` — must gate on `deleteResult.affected > 0` so `fileUnpins.inc()` only fires on confirmed row deletions (IN-01 correctness)

Original `abs(int4)` wrapped `hashtext($1)` in `pg_advisory_xact_lock` — overflows for INT_MIN (-2147483648), making those CIDs permanently undeletable; fixed by dropping `abs()` and letting int4→bigint sign-extend safely
`collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` had no `visited` Set — attacker-influenceable folder-metadata cycle caused unbounded recursion; cycle guard added mirroring `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS pattern

Drain refcount recheck + `unpinFile` ran outside the advisory lock (TOCTOU window); now wrapped in a transaction that first takes `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)::bigint)` matching guardedUnpin's lock — WR-01 fix
Fixed-duration `setTimeout(100)` sleeps used for async assertions — should use `vi.waitFor` for condition-based waiting to prevent CI flakiness (CodeRabbit nitpick)

WR-02 compensation path called `guardedUnpin` which returns early (no DB row) without touching Kubo — leaked physical pin on upload failure; fixed by calling `ipfsProvider.unpinFile(result.cid)` directly on the compensation catch

workflow: Parallel worktree execution works best when agents touch disjoint files; inter-plan file overlap (e.g. api-client) must be handled at merge time by verifying leaked files match the incoming branch before discarding
Post-PR CodeRabbit nitpicks bundle in the review body (pulls/N/reviews[].body), not as inline threads — `/resolve-pr-reviews` finds 0 threads but the review body contains actionable items
`env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh pr create` is required in this repo; standard `gh pr create` fails auth
macOS BSD `mktemp` only substitutes X's at the end of the template string, not mid-template — `$(mktemp /tmp/foo-XXXXXX.json)` works but `$(mktemp /tmp/XXXXXX-manifest.json)` leaves literal X's
For post-merge gates with lint-heavy pre-commit hooks, run manual `git commit` with a 5-min timeout rather than relying on cleanup-wave's internal commit which silently times out
The /simplify 4-agent parallel approach reliably surfaces extraction opportunities that single-pass review misses — found `fireAndForgetUnenrollEntries` and `collectFolderSubtree` consolidations
When verifying wave-executor key-links, forward-references to the wave's own deliverables are parsed as missing dependencies — verify the source file exists before treating as a real blocker

friction: GSD init misparse of `'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)'` as phantom dep `1.1` broke auto-recommendations; required manual override to proceed
cleanup-wave helper emitted opaque `merge_failed` with empty stderr when pre-commit hook caused its internal commit to fail — required diagnosing via `git status` to find MERGE_HEAD in progress

Worktree api-client generation leaked 131 files into orchestrator main tree after wave-1 merges fired post-commit hooks; blocked subsequent worktree merges with 'would be overwritten' — required file-by-file sha comparison before discarding
Husky stubs regenerated inside worktree made 50-05 worktree appear dirty to the merge helper before its plan work committed — required manual `git clean` in the worktree
gsd commit helper false-negative `commit_failed` on every tracking commit required `git log` verification each time to confirm the commit landed
Greptile declined PR #527 review entirely due to 240-file count from generated api-client — provides no review coverage on PRs involving DTO/openapi changes
CodeRabbit CLI review surface was documentation (REVIEW.md/VERIFICATION.md consistency) rather than code — useful but lower signal-to-noise than expected for a code review tool
